title: React → AWS Amplify Build Pipeline Migration
description: Migrate React frontend from K8s/Nginx deployment to AWS Amplify with CloudFront distribution.

steps.action: Connect Git repository to AWS Amplify Console: Amplify → New App → Host web app → connect repo/branch
steps.verify: Amplify detects React app; build settings auto-populated with npm run build

steps.action: Configure environment variables in Amplify: REACT_APP_API_URL, REACT_APP_COGNITO_* — match values from K8s ConfigMap
steps.verify: Amplify environment variables match K8s env list; no secrets in code

steps.action: Trigger first build and verify: Amplify Console → Run build — check build logs for zero errors
steps.verify: Build status = Succeeded; preview URL loads React app with correct data
steps.rollback: Fix build errors in amplify.yml; redeploy

steps.action: Set up custom domain in Amplify: Domain management → Add domain → verify CNAME DNS records
steps.verify: Domain status = Available; HTTPS certificate issued by ACM; app loads at custom domain
steps.rollback: Remove custom domain, revert DNS to K8s ingress

steps.action: Configure CloudFront behaviors for API routes (/api/*) to proxy to ALB/API Gateway; enable WAF if required
steps.verify: API calls from React app succeed via CloudFront proxy; error rate < 0.1%
steps.rollback: Remove CF behavior, revert API endpoint in Amplify env vars
